summary: No further work is available or warranted; the draft bytes are the last accepted update, so this creates no duplicate revision. The investigation is closed with a complete record: one asserted defect - shouldSnapshot compares the log store's last index against the cached snapshot index as unsigned values, so a node whose store sits below its snapshot index reports that it should snapshot and makes redundant snapshot attempts at an unchanged index, witnessed over two real producers (CheckRun 9cba2e79ff6c4019b0f0381690d9aaab after a TrailingLogs=0 user snapshot, CheckRun e5116cfe896549deb27799d6d871ed77 after a follower installed a snapshot above its own log) and measured as wasteful snapshot work with no safety effect (CheckRun a4a0cbfa094b4d1982032d9de0652861); three suspicions refuted with retained operands (voter-only commit eligibility, durable last vote across restart, AddVoter configuration lag as a bounded transient); and four durable Behaviors/Facts, two corrected under their own ids when measurement showed the per-interval implication and the stored-count proxy were unsupported. Remaining unknowns are recorded as limitations, chiefly the attempt-level cadence of the redundant snapshots.
